stemMd: What is the real domain of $h(x)=\sqrt{5-x}/(x+1)$?
explanationMd: The square root requires $5-x\ge0$, and the denominator requires $x\ne-1$. The endpoint 5 is allowed because its denominator is 6.

distractorRationale.b: Unnecessarily excludes 5 and overlooks the denominator restriction.
distractorRationale.c: Checks the denominator but not the radicand.
